measuredCandidateCommitRole: Uncommitted runtime source, identified by its full build-input fingerprint; the base commit alone does not identify it.

limitations: Local Chromium synthetic transport timings are not live Dev/Production Firebase latency or real authentication performance.
Transport interception disables browser HTTP cache; each fresh context is cold and later steps reuse evaluated modules.
Gzip level 9 loopback assets; CDP throttling applies to browser asset requests, intercepted synthetic responses are not a network-service model.

Only member/admin seed an unsigned synthetic Auth token; public/guest/register/reset remain signed out. Invented read responses exclude backend authorization, writes, payments, email and real App Check.
method.timing: Correct destination DOM over two consecutive animation frames. Later steps use browser click-capture timestamps. Not paint/LCP or React commit timing.
method.diagnostics: CPU windows include driver/instrumentation; observations accumulate across steps. Not headline performance evidence.

validationFollowup.timingScope: The original240/680 cohort is unchanged. Build validation/docs changed; emitted application assets remain identical. Profile completion is a separate required Dev timing.
